question: In Linear: Resolve the comment thread Priya Nair started on WEB-12 about the flaky tests.
final:
Done. I resolved the flaky-tests comment thread on WEB-12 ("Stabilize the CI pipeline").

That was the thread Priya joined: her comment "Agreed, the flaky tests are blocking merges." is a reply in the thread started by Omar Haddad ("Tests are flaky on CI again - three reruns today."). I marked that thread as resolved — verified the resolution is set on the root comment.

Note: Priya's other comment on WEB-12 ("Can we add the deploy checklist to the runbook?") is a separate top-level thread, so I left it open.
